Package parking.app

Class ParkingSystem

java.lang.Object
parking.app.ParkingSystem
public class ParkingSystem extends Object
Composition root of the application.

This is the single place where concrete infrastructure classes are instantiated and wired into the application use cases through the domain repository interfaces. Every other class in the system - the use cases, the domain entities - remains unaware of which concrete repository implementation is actually running underneath.

Both Main and ParkingTests build one instance of this class instead of constructing repositories and use cases by hand, which keeps the wiring logic in exactly one place.
